name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-faithful-athletic-grassland
title: Super Mario World Styled Faithful Athletic Grassland
description: This is a tileset that relies on vanilla SMW palettes and FG tiling to work. It's a mashup of the vanilla grass dirt with the mushroom walls from the athletic tileset! The grass is taken and edited from this old submission that I really like. Additionally there are some decorations for inside the dirt and some plants from SMM2.
